title: Route GitHits agent calls through private usage accounting
acceptance: The tracked MCP config invokes the private usage runtime with RISE attribution.
The command and entry use explicit absolute private runtime paths, independent of PATH and the launch working directory.
Missing private runtime configuration refuses the session without a direct unaccounted network fallback.

evidence.note: Direct-entry conformance passes for all five configs from nested directories with an empty PATH; no provider call is made.

activity.summary: Claimed the owner-requested Phase 0 agent tooling rollout; product runtime and public usage claims are out of scope.

summary: Developer tooling only. Private accounting is not a product feature or a reliability benchmark result.
